answer: VDF-gated attestation at the bridge: each validator must solve a sequential VDF before their signature counts, so parallelism buys nothing. A sonnet of timing proofs is chained per epoch. The pigment of validity is the wall-clock delay, not hashpower. A falcon strike of rented GPUs still waits the full serial delay, so N sybils cost N×T, not T. Honest bridges finalize anyway.
